# You should build libpcap under MacOS X as following

1. download the source

wget https://www.tcpdump.org/release/libpcap-1.11.0.tar.xz
tar xvf libpcap-1.11.0.tar.xz
cd libpcap-1.11.0
export MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.4
export CFLAGS=-mmacos-version-min=12.4

2. Configure and build 

./configure
make
sudo make install
make DESTDIR=~/REPO/libpcap-1.11.0 install

libpcap builds multiarch by default. so your /usr/local/lib/libpcap.a should be f
built for amd64 and x86_64. You can check with 
	file /usr/local/lib/libpcap.a


3. Package it

cd ~/REPO
pkgbuild --root libpcap-1.11.0  --ownership recommended --install-location / --version "1.11.0" --identifier <identifier>  "libpcap-1.11.0.pkg"
codesign -s <key> -
